name: Alcoholic Beverages
overview: Scripture provides clear guidance on the use of alcoholic beverages, warning against drunkenness and excess as seen in Proverbs and Romans, which associate strong drink with foolishness, strife, and unrighteous behavior. Leviticus instructs the priests to abstain from wine when ministering, emphasizing holiness and self-control. While wine is present in biblical events such as the wedding at Cana, believers are cautioned in Luke to guard their hearts against being overcharged by surfeiting and drunkenness, so they remain vigilant and faithful.
